about: Twenty candidates for named scenes, see docs/notes/twenty-galaxies.md. Coordinates are J2000 and approximate: check them in NED before asking for a cutout. Pictures under images/ are the agencies' screen size reduced to 1280 px, CC BY 4.0, to be shown with their credit unaltered.

tiers.A: a published orbit fitted to this object, and its shape is the stars' tides
tiers.B: a model or an archetype exists, but part of the look is gas or the fit is loose
tiers.C: no fitted model: the look can be approached, not reproduced
